name: Rumbleshot's Ammo
summary: Near the Grizzled Den, Rumbleshot's Ammo lies abandoned in the snow. Its courier fled from hungry wendigos before the crate could reach gunsmith Hegnar Rumbleshot in Dun Morogh.

sections.title: A Stranded Shipment
sections.body:
Hegnar Rumbleshot keeps a roadside arms shop on the mountain path from Coldridge Pass toward Anvilmar. Ironforge riflemen, mountaineers, and dwarven mortar teams drill in the snowy heights, so his supplies run low as quickly as powder burns.

Loslor sent the shot from Kharanos, but the shipment never reached the shelves. Its courier camped too close to the Grizzled Den. When the wendigos attacked, the courier fled in panic and left the heavy crate in their hunting grounds.

faq.answer: Hegnar Rumbleshot is a dwarven gunsmith with a shop off the road toward Anvilmar. He supplies local marksmen, hunters, and military gunners who practice in Dun Morogh's crags.

faq.q: How did the ammo crate get lost?
faq.answer: A courier carrying the crate camped near the Grizzled Den. When its wendigos attacked, the frightened courier fled and left the heavy crate in the snow.
The Grizzled Den is a cavern system in the mountains southwest of Kharanos. Wendigos make their lair there, putting solitary travelers on the surrounding slopes in danger.

angles.text: As a hunter in Dun Morogh, keep Hegnar's powder dry and his shot stocked. Dwarven firearms need a steady supply of ammunition.
As an engineer, you rely on shot and powder to test crafted firearms and experimental weaponry.
